projectState.summary: Byte 10c implements performed-offset data only. `src/performed-time.ts` calculates deterministic bounded `performedOffsetBeats` snapshots at schedule/commit time. Transport now assigns a canonical per-player `eventIndex` when committing a lookahead slot, and both velocity expression and performed timing read that same index. Events carry `eventIndex`, `performedOffsetBeats`, and `performedTiming`, while `absoluteBeat` remains grid truth. `window.transport.getState().performedTiming.latest` and the player `Offset` inspector row expose debug data. Synth fire time is unchanged and still grid-scheduled.
